acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: M Gessen tells Ira Glass about the surprising events that prompted them to begin reporting on their own family for their new podcast, The Idiot. They play the first episode of the series.

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Ira Glass and M Gessen continue to talk through the story of M’s cousin, Allen Gessen. They play more clips from the podcast, and we finally hear about the big, shocking thing that snapped their family apart.

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: M Gessen tells Ira Glass about Allen’s trial, and we hear a recording of his conversation with the undercover agent.
